original_wisa_caption: The video opens with a completely dark scene, setting a mysterious and suspenseful tone. Gradually, a small flame appears on the left side of the frame, flickering gently against the black background. This flame grows slightly larger and more defined, casting a warm, orange glow that contrasts sharply with the surrounding darkness. As the video progresses, another small flame emerges in the distance, to the right of the first one. This second flame also begins to grow, becoming more prominent and steady. The two flames continue to burn, each growing larger and more defined, while the rest of the scene remains shrouded in darkness. The camera remains stationary throughout, focusing solely on these two flames as they illuminate the otherwise pitch-black environment. The overall atmosphere is one of quiet intensity, with the flickering flames serving as the sole source of light and movement in the scene.
caption: A tall, narrow orange-yellow flame burns against a black frame, its base anchored low on the left, the tip rising and flickering. The flame is already alight at the start and still burns at the end. As the action progresses, the tip, starting left-leaning, tends to shift rightward relative to the base, so the flame sways from a left-leaning posture toward an upright, slightly right-leaning one. Its height and width pulse subtly over time, while the body's brightness also fluctuates. To the right, a smaller dimmer orange ember appears and fades, flickering in and out rather than translating. Several faint points of light—a white dot near the upper center, a white dot at the far right, and tiny orange specks—remain at nearly identical positions throughout. The background points appear fixed, suggesting a stationary camera. The flame's sway and flicker, along with the ember's pulsing, are the main visible changes.

draft_caption: A tall, narrow orange-yellow flame burns against a black frame, its base anchored low on the left, the tip rising and flickering. The flame is already alight when the clip opens and still burns as it ends, showing no ignition or extinction. Over the excerpt the tip, starting left-leaning, gradually shifts rightward relative to the fixed base, so the flame sways from a left-leaning posture toward an upright, slightly right-leaning one. Its height stretches a little early on and then holds roughly steady, while the body's brightness and width pulse subtly frame to frame. To the right, a smaller dimmer orange ember appears and fades, flickering in and out rather than translating. Three faint points of light—a white dot near the upper center, a white dot at the far right, and a tiny orange speck mid-frame—stay pinned at identical positions throughout. The stationary background confirms the camera does not move. The flame's own sway and flicker remain the only visible motion.
